name: x4-forge-studio
description: X4: Foundations modding studio for visual Mission Director graphs, native X4-aware XML editing, deterministic validation, safe patches, and guarded package and deploy workflows.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Author, validate, package, and deploy X4: Foundations mods in one local workspace.

[Open Studio](command:x4forge.openStudio)

The Studio connects a visual Mission Director graph with native X4-aware XML editing, deterministic diagnostics, and guarded package and deploy workflows. Configure your X4 installation and reference/schema data in Studio Settings.

[Open Mod Folder](command:x4forge.openModFolder)
[Create Agent Key](command:x4forge.createAgentKey)
[Show Backend Logs](command:x4forge.showLogs)
[Stop Local Backend](command:x4forge.stopSidecar)

x4forge.attachUrl.description: Attach to an already-running local Forge before starting a sidecar. The extension attaches only after this URL answers the Forge agent-schema probe and never stops a server it attached to.

x4forge.forgeRoot.description: Optional path to a built Forge checkout containing dist/server.cjs and node_modules. Leave empty to use the app bundled inside the extension.

x4forge.stateDir.description: Directory for the sidecar's workspace state (X4_STATE_DIR). Leave empty for per-user extension storage. Point it at an existing Forge checkout's .studio-state only while that checkout's server is stopped; the attach probe normally prevents unsafe sharing.

x4forge.nodePath.description: Path to the Node.js executable used to run the sidecar. Leave empty to use node from PATH. The sidecar requires a real Node installation with ABI-compatible native modules.

x4forge.autoOpen.description: Open the X4 Forge Studio automatically when a (trusted) workspace finishes loading. Useful for dedicated modding workspaces; off by default.

enumDescriptions: Launch the backend with --inspect and auto-attach the Node debugger (breakpoints, stepping). Works in VS Code and Antigravity.
Like inspect, but pause at the first line so you can debug startup; continue execution in the debugger to start the server.
x4forge.debug.description: Attach a Node debugger to the managed backend sidecar. For SOURCE-LEVEL (TypeScript) breakpoints, also set x4forge.forgeRoot to a built repo checkout (its bundle keeps sourcemaps); against the bundled app you debug at the bundled-JS level. Default off.

x4forge.writeXmlAssociations.description: When opening a mod folder, optionally write per-file xml.fileAssociations for applicable game XSDs (plain-rooted factions, gamestarts, and addon files; never diff patches). Requires an XML extension to use these associations. Off by default; Forge validation remains authoritative.

x4forge.twoWayEditing.description: When authored text changes on disk, offer an explicit guarded import into the canvas. Compare-and-swap protection refuses lossy imports or concurrent canvas changes instead of overwriting.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: X4 Forge compiles, validates, and packages mod projects (filesystem writes and local process execution). The extension is disabled in untrusted workspaces.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The Forge backend requires a local filesystem.
